a ba stā raḥ byings gsal byed mtha' can las kyang de'o/ /a ba sngon ma can gyi mṛ dzū ṣa dag yon tan/ mardza'i mārdzi'o/ /thung ngu'i ring po/ /dza'i ga a bā mārgaḥ de bzhin du ni sngon ma can gyi/ ṣa 'jig /ni ṣā daḥ slob ma la phan pa'i mdor/ a dhyā ya n+yā ya u dyā ba saṃ hā ra ā dhār/ a bā ya rnams kyang ngo*/ /zhes a dhi sngon ma can gyi ing klog/ni sngon ma can gyi iṇa 'gro /ud sngon ma can gyi yu sre ba dang saṃ sngon ma can gyi hrinya 'phrog pa dang*/ āng sngon ma can gyi dhṛnya 'dzin pa dang*| āng sngon ma can gyi bā 'gro ba rnams kyang ghanya sbyar ba'i tshig phrad do// ud ka zhes chu min pa'i don la tshig phrad yin te/ añdzu khyad par du byed/ uta sngon ghanya 'ang ngo*/ /dra ba'i don la/ ā nā ya tshig phrad yin te/ āng sngon ma can gyi ṇīnya thob pa la byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ī ṣar dang*/ dur dang*/ su rnams nye ba'i tshig la byings dka' ba'i don can ḍu kṛnya lta bu dang*/ sla ba'i don can bhu dza skyong ba lta bu rnams la yang ni khal rkyen du 'gyur zhing*/ kha yig rjes 'brel dang*/ ā yig dngos po dang las dag la/ kṛtya kta sogs kyi don no// ī ṣad ka raḥ du ka raḥ su ka raḥ ī ṣad bho dzaḥ dur bho dzaḥ su bho dzaḥ nye ba'i tshig snga ma de rnams la brjod bya byed pa po dang*/ las dag ston pa la'ang*/ bhū yod pa dang ḍu kṛnya dag gi'ang rkyen ni khal lo/ /bar du a dhya gzhug cing thung ngu sogs kyis ma ā ga ma byas pas/ ī ṣa dā ḍhyaṃ bha baḥ du rā ḍhyaṃ bha baḥ swā ḍhyaṃ bha baḥ de bzhin du bha'i gnas su ka raḥ'o/ /byed pa po dang las la zhes pa glo bur bar byas nas/ dka' sla'i don la byings pā btung ba sogs āta mtha' rnams las nye ba'i tshig snga ma de rnams yod pa la yu'i rkyen bya ste/ āta mtha'i nang nas*/ da ri drī ti min pa la'o/ /āe ṣad pā naḥ duḥpā naḥ su pā naḥ

nye tshig de rnams la shwa su rjes su ston/ yu dha 'khrug /dṛ shir lta/ nyi dhṛ ṣa spyi gtol/ mṛṣa bzod pa rnams kyi rkyen yu dang khal yang na'o/ /ī ṣa tstshā sa naḥ.ī ṣatstshā saḥduḥshā sa naḥ duḥ shā saḥsu shā sa naḥ su shā sa ཿ de bzhin du/ ī ṣa dyo dha naḥ dang*/ yo dhaḥ duryo dha naḥ dang*/ yo dhaḥ su yo dha naḥdang yo dhaḥ ī ṣad darṣa naḥsogs dang*/ ī ṣad marṣa ṇaḥ sogs so/ /gsum pa ni byed pa po gcig pa ste mtshungs pa'i don can gyi byings rnams las nye ba'i tshig gang rung las 'das pa'i don ston pa rnams la/ tum rkyen du bya'o/ /itstsha ti bhoktuṃ/ bañtsi ti bhoktuṃ/ byed pa po gcig min na/ de ba dattaṃ bhañdzā naṃ itstsha ti/ yadzñā dattaḥ bhudza/ brta mā na zhes pas/ ā na sha /ru dha sogs las na sgra/ de'i bi ka ra ṇa'i mtha' dbyi/ ta sde'i tsaṭa'i sogs/ 'o na dper brjod de ni/ bza' bar byed pa 'dod pa'i don can du snang la bya ba la bya ba'i don la wuṇa tum dag go /zhes bshad zin pas 'di bshad pa don med do zhe na/ byed pa po gcig pa sogs kyi khyad par yod pa dang*| wuṇa mi 'jug pa'i don du yin pas don yod do/ /bzhi pa ni kā la grangs*/ saṃ sngon ma can gyi a ya 'gro/ be lā 'byed pa rnams la dang*/ nus pa'i don saṃ sngon ma can gyi/ artha nye bar slong ba rnams la'ang rim pa bzhin du ghanya dang*/ a tsa dang āng dang*/ ā rnams rkyen du byas pa'i mthar bhudza skyong ba la tum byin pa ni kā la bhoktuṃ/ sa ma ya bhoktuṃ/ be lā bhoktuṃ/ sa martho bhoktuṃ/ 'ang sgra ni gzhan la'ang 'jug par 'dod do/ /āpl̥ khyab pa la/ pa ri sngo ma can la kta sbyin pa dang sbyar bas/ bhoktuṃ patyāptaḥ arya ti zhes pa ni 'os pa zhes pa ste/ byings tsam las 'os pa'i don can gyi byed pa po la tṛ tsa 'gyur ro/ /tsa dbyangs don sogs sngar bzhin te/dharme me kartā/ ḍu kṛnya la sbyar zhing si byin pa'o/

/buṇa tṛ tsas grub pa la sbyor ba smos pa ni byapyad pa pathrar 'os pa la 'dun pas gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /shakl̥ nus pa'i byings kyi sha ka dang ba ha thob pa la'ang nus pa'i don la/ ā nī ya dang*/ ghya ṇa/ sogs kṛtya'i ming can gyi rkyen rnams sbyor ro/ /sha ka nī ya/ shākyā/ ba ha nī ya/ bā hyā/ āpa byas pa'o/ /bsgo ba dang khas len pa dang*/ dus la 'bab pa rnams la byings tsam la/ kṛ tya rnams 'gyur ro/ /rim pa bzhin/ bha ba tā ka ṭaḥ karta byaḥ ka ra ṇi ya dang*/ ma ya ka ṭaḥ karta byaḥdang*/ a dhu nā kā ṭaḥ karta byaḥrnams te/ kṛnya la/ ta bya dang*/ dang po la a nī ya sbyar ba'o/ /byings tsam las gdon mi za ba'i don dang*/ bu lon len pa'i don dag la ṇi ni'i rkyen 'gyur zhing*/ sbyor tshul bshad zin pa bzhin no/ /a ba shyaṃ kā rī/ a ba shyaṃ dā yī/ sa ha/ sra dā yī/ kṛnya dang dā nya la sbyar ba'o/ /byings tsam las ming gi don dang smon pa'i don la tika dang*/ kṛta rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /kṛta dag kyang zhes slar yang smos pa ni tika gis bkag gam snyam pa bzlog pa'o/ /ta nu rgyas/ ṣa nu sbyin/ bhū yod/ ti ka/ ka rjes 'brel/ tanti/ santi/ bhū ti/ ḍu dānya kṛta ces pas dbyangs las ya/ āta khan zhes pas/ ā'i/ i yon tan/ āpa/ bdun pa'i supa/ de yā su/ byings de la kta/ dhā min pa'i dā'i data/ de ba datta/ gnyis pa ni byings kyi don dang 'brel ba'i khyad par dang khyad par can gyi dngos po mtshon par gyur pa la/ kṛta kyi rkyen rnams legs par 'gyur ro/ /'o na 'dir khyad par dang khyad par can gang la byed ce na| kun bshad kyi rkyen rnams kyi khyad par can te/ bya gtso bo nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /kṛta kyi mtha' can ni khyad par te/ kṛta rnams ni byed pa po la sgrub pa'i phyir dang*/ byed pa po yang bya ba'i gzhan dbang nyid kyis yin no/ /des na byapyad pa pathra'i don la ya dza las 'das pa la'o/

/zhes pas ya dza la ṇi ni rkyen du sbyar bas yā dzī/ zhes pa mchod sbyin byas zin to/ /zhes pa yin la/ dza ni las 'byung 'gyur gyi don la/ shwasta nī sbyar ba ni/ dza ni tā zhes pa/ khyad par can te/ de ltar na 'das zin pa dang*/ 'byung 'gyur dus tha dad pas/ khyad par dang khyad par can du mi rigs kyang*/ kṛta kyi rkyen gyi nus pas/ lhan cig tu sbyar ba na| de ltar rigs pa ni/ agni ṣto mas mchod sbyin byas zin to zhes pa la/ agn-i ma yā dzī/ putt+ro sya dza nī tā/ zhes pa lta bu dang*/ go mā nā sīta/ go mān bha bi tā| zhes sogs slob phan du rgyasapar 'byung ba rnams so/ /zhes pa kṛta rnams su mdo las rkang pa lnga pa'i bshad pa rdzogs so// //kṛta rkang pa drug pa ni/ rkyen gyi rnam gzhag dang*/ rkyen gyi lus 'gyur dang*| rkyen gyi dwogs gcod gsum du gnas pa las/ dang po la nye tshig la ltos pa dang*/ brjod bya la ltos pa'i rkyen gyi rnam gzhag gnyis las/ dang po la'ang dgag pa dang*/ las dang byed pa dang rnam dbye dang mi zad pa'i nye ba'i tshig la ltos pa lnga'o/ /dang po dgag pa nye ba'i tshig la ltos pa ni/ byings tsam las a lam dang kha lu dag nye ba'i tshig la ste/ de yang dgag pa'i don can la rkyen/ kt+wā yang na 'gyur zhing*/ yang na byed pa dang gzhi dag la yuṭa'o/ /kṛnya a laṃ kraṃ twā/ kha lu kṛ twā/ yang na a maṃ ka ra ṇe na/ kha lu ka ra ṇe na/ ṭā ina'o/ /dgag pa min na ghanya sbyar bas/ a laṃ kā ra/ kha lu kā ra a laṃ kha lu min na dgag pa yin kyang*/ ḍu kṛnya la dgag pa'i mā sngon du byas nas/ adya ta nī/ si byas pas/ mā kārṣī si tsa dang*/ īṭa byas pa'o/ /med phyir sbyin pa'i byings las dgag pa la kt+wā/ a ba sngon du byas nas/ de yis bsdu ba dang*/ bsdu ba las 'byung ba la yapa byas pas/ a ba mā ya/ zhar byung ni dgag pa'i nye tshig med kyang*/ byed pa po gcig tu mtshungs pa'i byings gnyis dag gi nang nas byings snga ma'i dus kyi don la 'jug bzhin pa'i byings las kt+wā 'gyur to/

/bkrus nas ster zhes pa/ ṣṇā gtsang ba dang ḍu dānya gnyis dag gi snga ma'i dus gtso bas/ snā twā da dā ti/ 'thungs nas nyal ba la pīng btung*/ shīng nyal/ pī twā she ti/ pha rol dang tshu rol sbyor ba'i don can gyi byings las kt+wā'o/ /ri rgal nas chu klung zhes pa'i skad dod| a ti kra mya parba taṃ na dī/ kra mu g.yo ba la/ kt+wa'i yapa'o/ /de bzhin du chu klung rgal nas ri bo zhes pa/ a prā pya na dī pa

ta/ ā pl̥ khyab pa la/ yapa dang nyan dang pra sngon du byas pa'o/ /byed pa po gcig gi byings don gnyis dag gi nang nas dus snga ma sgrub par byed pa yang yang gi don can la byings las ṇam yang 'gyur zhing*/ yang na kt+wā dang de gnyis ka la tshig kyang gnyis su 'gyur ro// bhū dza za/ pīng btung*/ bhūkt+wā/ bhukt+wā/ bra dza ti/ bho dzaṃ bho dzaṃ/ pra dza ti/ pī twā pī twā// she ti/ pā yaṃ pā yaṃ she ti/ 'di pā btung ba la ā yi byas pa rnam par 'grub pa'o/ 'o na yang yang la de'i gnyis brjod pa grub pas/ tshig kyang gnyis so zhes pa mi dgos so zhe na/ ji ltar mthong ba bzhin khyad par 'dod pa sogs gzhan la'ang tshig gnyis brjod pa'i don na'o zhes bzhed de/ tsand+ra par/ khyad par 'dod pa dang*| yang yang dag la gnyis so zhes pas/ gra su za/ gra sa'i ā yang ngo zhes pas ma'i rkyen dang*/ sa'i ā/ si rnam bcad/ ra mu rtse/ a nī ya/ snga ma gnyis brjod pas/ grā mo grā mo ra ma ṇī yaḥ rtogs dka' na/ gnyis su ma zad gsum la sogs par brjod par bshad de/ tsand+ra par/ kun tu 'khrul pa la ji srid kyis rtogs par ro/ /zhes pa'i 'grel pa/ bu dha khong du chud pa la/ pañtsa mī swa/ di sogs las yan/ mdo des lan gsum brjod pas/ bu dhya swa bu dhya swa bu dhya swa zhes pa'i don bshad do/ /a gre dang pra tha ma dang*/ pūrba rnams nye ba'i tshig la byings las kt+wā dang ṇam yang na 'gyur bar rnam par bshad pa'o/ /agre bhukt+wā dang*| agre bho dzaṃ sogs te/ bhu dza skyong ba dang sbyor ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni las nye ba'i tshig la krinya las smod pa'am khros tshig la kha minya 'gyur ro kha dang inya rjes 'brel sngar bzhin byas pas/ tsau raṃ kā ra mā kro sha ti/ bṛ ṣa laṃ kā ra mā kro sha ti/ ro myang ba'i don can la nye ba'i tshig la ro myang brjod pa la'ang byings rkyen de'o/ /sā duṃ kā raṃ bhung kte/ la ba ṇaṃ kā raṃ bhung kte/ las nye ba'i tshig an+ya thā dang*/

e baṃ dang*/ ka thaṃ dang*/ itthaṃ rnams la/ gal te grub pa'i sbyor ba min par don med pa'i sbyor ba yin na kṛnya las rkyen de'o/ /an+ya thā kā raṃ bhung kte sogs so/ /don yod na kt+wā sbyar bas kṛtwā sbyar ro/ /las nye ba'i tshig la ya thā dang*| ta tha dag la mi nus pa'i lan la byings rkyen de'o/ /ya thā kā raṃ sogs so| |las nye ba'i tshig mtha' dag gis khyad par du byas pa la/ dṛ sha zhes pa/ dṛ shir lta ba las rkyen ṇama'o/ /ka n+yā darshaṃ pā pa ya ti yā bad nye ba'i tshig la binda ti zhes pa/ bi thob pa dang*/ dzī ba srog 'dzin pa dag gi yang rkyen de'o/ /yā bad be daṃ bhung kte/ yā bta dzī baṃ patkā raṃ/ pū dza yā mi/ las nye ba'i tshig tsarma dang u da ra dag la pū ri tshim pa zhes pa in mtha' can las ṇama'o/ /tsarma pū raṃ st+ṝ ṇā ti| u da ra pū raṃ bhung kte byings de las nye ba'i tshig can la char ba'i tshad brjod pa la ste rkyen de dang ū dbyi ba'ang yang na bya'o/ /goṣpa dang pu raṃ de bo bṛṣtaḥ goṣpa daṃ praṃ/ de bo bṛṣta/ tse la artha zhes pa/ gos kyi don la pi zhes pa/ yī sgra la'o zhes pa'i byings la in dang*/ arti hrī sogs kyis pa ā ga ma dang*/ ya dbyi ba byas pas/ pi ste/ de las ṇam gyi rkyen 'gyur zhing*/ ho tse la paṃ bṛṣt+waḥ las nye ba'i tshig ga tra dang pu ru ṣa dag la/ snā zhes pa/ ṣṇā gtsang ba'i byings las ṇaṃ 'gyur te/ gal te char pa'i tshad du 'gyur ba na'o/ /gā tra snā yaṃ bṛṣta/ bu ru ṣa snā yaṃ bṛṣto de ba/ las nye ba'i tshig ni mū la dang*/ sa mū dag la kaṣa 'tshe ba las ṇama'o/ /ni mū la kā ṣaṃ kaṣa ti/ sa mū la kā ṣaṃ kaṣa ti/ shuṣka dang*/ tsūrṇa dang*| rūkṣa rnams las nye ba'i tshig la piṣl̥ phye mar byed pa las ṇama'o/ /shuṣka pe ṣaṃ| tsūrṇape ṣaṃ/ rūkṣa pe ṣaṃ/ rnams las pi naṣti sbyar ba'o/ /las nye ba'i tshig dzī ba zhes pa la gra ha nye bar len pa las ṇama'o/

/dzī ba gra haṃ/ a kṛta nye ba'i tshig la/ kṛnya las ṇama'o/ /a kṛta kā raṃ/ las nye ba'i tshig sa mu la zhes pa la hanti las ṇama'o/ /sa mū la ghā taṃ/ gsum pa ni/ byed pa nye ba'i tshig la/ hanti las ṇama'o/ /pā ṇi ghā taṃ/ bhū mi hanti/ byed pa nye ba'i tshig lag pa'i don la/ gra ha brti bṛta ces pa/ gra ha len/ bṛ tu bshad pa tshur tsur sogs las in mtha' can dang*/ bṛ tu 'jug pa rnams kyi rkyen yang ṇama'o/ /lag pa'i don ni/ hasti dang*/ ka ra dang*/ pā ṇi sogs te/ hasti gra haṃ sogs dang*/ hasti brtam/ sogs phrag gnyis sbyar ba'o/ /byed pa nye ba'i tshig rang gi don brjod pa sogs dang*| go dang*/ pi tṛ dang*/ rai zhes sogs rnams la puṣa rgyas pa las ṇama'/ོ/ swa po ṣaṃ sogs so/ /byed pa nye ba'i tshig gsher ba'am snum pa ston par byed pa/ ti la snum pa byings las bsgrub pa'i tai la zhes pa lta bu la pi ṣl̥ phye mar byed pa las ṇama'o/ /tai la pe ṣaṃ pi naṣti til mar gyi snum snum par byed pa'am gsher bar byed sogs so/ /byapyad pa pathras khyad par du byas pa'i gzhi nye ba'i tshig la bandha 'ching ba'i byings las dang*/ ming la'ang de las ṇama'o/ /tsakra bandham/ kroñtsa bandham/ dzī ba dang pu ru ṣa dag nye ba'i tshig la byapyad pa pathra/ brjod pa dag la na shi ba hi/ zhes pa/ ṇa sha mi mthong ba dang*/ ba ha thob pa las ṇa ma'/ོ/ dzī ba nā shaṃ /pu ru ṣa bā haṃ/ byed pa po urdha nye ba'i tshig la shu ṣi pū ra zhes pa/ shuṣa skoms pa dang*/ pū ri tshim pa las ṇama'o/ ūrdhā sho ṣaṃ/ ūrdhā pū raṃ/byed pa po brjod pa'i las nye ba'i tshig la'ang*/ byings tsam las ṇam 'gyur te/ de yang dpe nye bar 'jal ba la'o/ /a dza ka nā shaṃ naṣta/ gong gi ni mū la sa mū la dag la ka ṣa las so/ /zhes sogs nas brtsams pa'i byings rnams las ṇam sbyar ba ni/ de rnams nyid kyis don mtshungs pa'i byings de la rkyen gzhan yang rjes su sbyor bar bya'o/

/bzhi pa la rnam dbye gsum pa la dang*/ gsum bdun thun mongs la dang*/ gnyis pa la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni rnam dbye gsum pa'i mtha' can nye ba'i tshig la/ u pa sngon ma can gyi daṃ sha mche ba'i byings kyi rkyen yang ṇama'o/ /mū la ke no pa daṃ sha bhu kta/ gsum pa'i mtha' can nye ba'i tshig ha na sogs/ 'tshe ba'i don can gyi byings las kyang rkyen de 'gyur te*/ /de yang byings snga ma de'i rjes su/ phyi ma sbyor ba'i sgo nas las gcig las so/ /daṇḍe no pa ghā taṃ gā kā la/ bsnun pa dang*/ bgrang ba'i tshig kyang ba lang rnams su grangs gcig pa'o/ gnyis pa ni gsum par ma zad/ rnam dbye bdun pa nye ba'i tshig la'ang chu dang srid kyi tshad dang*/ ā patti zhes pa/ chos che'i don dag la byings las ṇama'o/ /kṛṣa bri/ ud sngon ma can la ṇam sbyar ba ni/ lhag ces pa yin pas| tshad sor gnyis kyi dang*/ gnyis su lhag ces brjod 'dod na/ dw+yang gu le na ud karṣa ma/ dw+yang gu le ud karṣam/ chos che ba la gra ha len pa la/ ṇam sbyar ba ni/ ke she na gra haṃ/ u pa sngon ma can gyi gsum pa dang bdun pa nye ba'i la| pī ḍa kun nas thibs/ /ru dhir sgrib/ /kṛ sha rnam par rko ba rnams ni/ pī ḍa dang ru dha dang*/ karṣa zhes pa yin la/ de rnams las kyang ṇama'o/ /pā bhyam u pa pī ḍaṃ/ paṣwa yo tu pa pī ḍaṃ/ bra dze no pa ro dhaṃ/ bra dze u pa ro dhaṃ/ pa ne no pa karṣaṃ/ pā ṇi u pa karṣaṃ/ gsum bdun gnyis dang*/ 'dra ba'i gcig tshig nye ba'i tshig la'ang sbyar ba mthong ste/ pa pa pī ḍaṃ/ nges par kun sbyin pa nye ba'i tshig la byings tsam las yongs su 'dod pa la ṇama'o/ ud sngon ma can gyi/ sthā gnas pa la ṇam/ de sha yyā yā dang sbyar bas/ sha yyā yā ud sthā yaṃ/ āta mtha' rnams kyi itsa la sogs so/ /gsum pa ni gnyis pa'i mtha' nye ba'i tshig la byings las yongs su 'dod pa'i don la ṇa ma'o/ /yaṣti la gnyis pa'i am sbyar ba'i yaṣtim dang sbyar ba'i gra ha nye bar len pa la ṇam byas nas nye tshig g-i bsdu ba byas pa ni yaṣti grā haṃ/

rnam dbye gnyis pa'i mtha' nye ba'i tshig la byings las rang gi yan lag la ṇam de yang ma nges pa'i don la'o/ /bhru bi dang sbyar ba'i kṣipa ded pa la byin pas/ bhru bi kṣe paṃ ka tha ya ti/ gnyis pa'i mtha' nye ba'i tshig la byings las yongs su nyon mongs par byed pa la'ang ṇama'o/ /kle sha gnod pa la sbyar bas/ tsitta kle sha gnyis pa'i mtha' nye ba'i tshig la/ bi shes pa ti pa de skandhi zhes pa'i bi sha 'jug pa 'gro/ pa da 'gro/ skandhi skems pa rnams kyi brjod bya khyab par bya ba dang*/ yang yang dag la 'jug pa la ṇama'o/ /dngos po mtha' dag gi don dang 'brel ba ni khyab pa'i don yin la/ ge haṃ ge ha ma nu pra zhes pa dang*/ 'jug tu āste sbyar ba ni ge haṃ ge ha ma nu pra be sha mā ste/ de bzhin du/ pā ta/ pā da/ skandha māste sogs so/ /yang yang gi don ni bsten pa yin pas/ de la ge ha ma nu pra be sha ma nu pra be sha māste sogs sa/ོ/ gnyis pa'i mtha' nye ba'i tshig dus brjod pa rnams la/ tri ṣi zhes pa/ nyi tṛṣa skoms| a ti sngon ma can gyi/ a su 'phen pa dag gi rkyen yang*/ ṇam yin te/ bya ba'i bar la 'jug bzhin pa la'o/ /dw+ya hantarṣaṃ gāḥ dw+ya ha ma tyā saṃ gāḥ nā man gyi sgra gnyis pa'i mtha' nye ba'i tshig las āng sngon ma'i di sha 'dor ba dang*/ gra ha nye bar len pa dag gi las ṇama'o/ /nā mā n+yā de shaṃ/ nā mā ni grā haṃ/ lnga pa ni mi zad pa nye ba'i tshig la ḍu kṛnya las ji ltar 'dod pa bshad pa min pa la kt+wā'ang rkyen du 'gyur te/ 'ang sgras ṇama'o/ kashtsita utstsheḥkṛ twā/ yang na kā raṃ/ kt+wā yapa tu bsgyur na kṛtya/ tiryaka ces pa/ nye ba'i tshig la a brga zhes pa/ 'gro ba'i don la'ang rkyen de gnyis so/ /tirya ka kṛ twā/ sogs sngon ma bzhin no// rang gi yan lag nye ba'i tshig la/ tas rkyen gyi mtha' la yang*/ kṛnya'i byings las rkyen de gnyis bya'o/ /mu ṣa taḥ kṛ twā sogs so/ /tuṣṇāe ma zhes pa nye ba'i tshig la'ang bhū las de gnyis bya'o/

/tuṣṇimbhū twā sogs so/ /'dir slob phan du yod pa'i don rnams dang sha ka dhṛ ṣa dzñā glā gha ṭa ra bha la bha ka ma sa ha ardha rnams la tuma'o/ /zhes bshad pa ni/ shagno ti bhoktuṃ/ dhṛṣṇo ti bhoktuṃ dzā na ti/ gā ya ti| gzhan rnams de ste/ an bi sbyar ba'i mthar/ bhoktuṃ sbyar ba ste sla'/ོ/ gnyis pa brjod bya la ltos pa'i rkyen gyi rnam gzhag la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ kta bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byed pa po brjod par byed pa la byings tsam las kṛta kyi rkyen rnams 'gyur ro/ /don nges pa bstan pa med pa'i rkyen rnams rang gi don la 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i tshig las/ buṇa tṛtsa ghanya sogs rnams sngar bshad pa'i rang rang gi don la 'gyur ba yin pa las byed pa po zhes sogs 'di rnams kyis rang rang gi don nges pa rnams bkag pa'o/ /kā ra ka /kartā/ ku bhā kā ra/ rkyen gsum po kṛnya dang sbyar ba'o/ /dngos po dang las kyi don dag la krita kyi nang tshan kṛtya rnams dang*/ kta dang khal gyi don zhes pa/ khal dngos dang de'i don can de dang lhan cig spyod pa'i rkyen rnams bzung bar bya'o/ /de yang dngos po la kṛtya ta bya a nī ya dag ā sa nye bar sdod/ shīng nyal ba la sbyar nas/ iṭa yon tan/ e a ya/ ā si ta byaṃ bha ba tā/ sha ya nī yaṃ bha ba tā/ las kyi don la/ kṛnya bhu dza ta bya/ ghyaṇa/ yon tan/ karta byaḥ ka ṭo bha ba tā/ bho dzya o da no bha ba tā/ kta dngos po la sbyar na/ ā pi taṃ/ bha ba tā/ si mu'o/ /las la| ni kṛtaḥ ka ṭo bha ba tā/ khal dngos po la sbyar na/ bha baṃ bha ba tā/ las la sbyar na ka ro bha ba tā/ yu dngos po la sbyar na/ sthā naṃ bha ba tā/ las la sbyar na/ dā no bha ba tā/ gnyis pa ni/ brjod bya dang po'i las ston par byed pa la/ byings gang rung las byed pa po la dang*/ 'ang sgras ji ltar rigs pa la kta rkyen du 'gyur ra/ོ/ byed pa po byed 'dod dang por 'jug go zhes pa la/

pra kṛ+-i taḥ ka ṭaṃ de ba dattaḥ kṛnya la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po'i las la sbyar na/ pra kṛ taḥ ka ṭo de ba datte na/ byed pa po dang dngos po dang las kyi don gsum po gang rung la 'jug pa gzhir byas pa'i glaml̥'agro lta bu 'gro ba'i don dang*/ glai dga' ba zad pa lta bu'i las med pa dang*/ shl̥ṣa sbyor ba dang*/ shīng nyal ba dang*/ sthā gnas/ ā sa stod| ba sa nges par gnas/ dza na dang ru ha rab tu skye/ dzirya ti zhes pa/ dzṛ lang tsho nyaṃs pa rnaṃs las kyang kta rkyen du bya'o/ byed pa po la ga to grā maṃ de ba datta/ dngos po la ga te/ las la ga to grā mo/ /de gnyis la'ang de ba datte na/ zhes pa sbyar ba'o/ /glai la/ āta las mthar gnas brtsegs pa las zhes sogs kyis kta'i ta na ru bsgyur bas dang por lha sbyin gyis re lde byed 'dod/ glā no bha bān/ ā shl̥ṣto gu tuṃ bha bān/ de bzhin du/ a ti sha yi to/ u pa sthi to/ u pā si to/ a nū ṣi to/ a nu dzā to/ rnams la'ang gu tuṃ bha bān sbyar ba dang*/ ā tu ḍho bṛkṣaṃ? bha bān/ a nu dzirṇ+ṇo bṛ ṣa lī de ba dattaḥsbyar te/ shīng dang ā sa la iṭa sthā la dya ti sya ti sogs/ ba sa la saṃ pra/ dza na/ dhuṭa la kha ni sa ni dza ni zhes pas/ na'i a| ru ha la ha'i ḍha/ tha ma la ra las niṣṭhā'i ta'i na dang*/ ṝta mtha'i yon tan med pa/ sogs/ dngos po dang las la sogs pa ni tshig grogs dang rnam dbye'i dbang gis so/ /dā sṛ sbyin pa la a tsa sbyar ba'i dā sa dang*/ go sngon ma can gyi ha na 'tshe ba la ṭak sbyar ba'i ghna dag ni yang dag par rab tu sbyin pa'i don la tshig phrad du bya'o/ /dā saḥ go ghnaḥ nyi bhī 'jig pa las bhī'i ṣu yang na'/ོ/ zhes pas/ ka rkyen du byas shing gha dang ka rjes 'brel byas pas bhī ma dang*/ bhiṣma zhes sogs rnams ni nges par kun sbyin pa'i don la tshig phrad du bya'/ོ/ 'di gnyis ni krita nyid kyi phyir byed pa po thob pa skabs kyi dmigs bsal la/ོ/

yang dag par rab tu sbyin pa dang*/ nges par kun sbyin pa de dag las/ skabs gzhan du rkyen uṇa la sogs pa rnams sbyar bar bya'o/ /ta nu rgyas pa la tun/ na rjes 'brel/ kṛṣa rko ba la i sbyar bas/ tantuḥ karṣi 'dir bdag gi bla mas tsand+ra pa'i uṇa'i 'grel pa la brten pa mang du bkod pa rnams ni 'grel pa de nyid du rtogs par bya ba yin pas/ 'dir ma spros so/ /ā sa sdod pa lta bu'i brtan pa dang*/ bradza 'gro ba sogs dang*/ bhu dza za ba sogs zas kyi don can gyi byings rnams las gzhi brjod pa la'ang kta'o/ /snga ma gnyis la iṭa dang bar pa la pra sngon du byas pas ā si taḥ pra bra dzi taḥ bhuktaṃ/ gnyis pa la rkyen dngos kyi dang*/ de la brten pa'i byings kyi dang*/ gnyis ka la brten pa'i phrad kyi lus 'gyur bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kṛta kyi rkyen yu dang yuṭa la sogs pa'i yu dbyangs bcas dang*/ bunya dang wuṇa tṛtsa'i wuṇa sogs wu dbyangs bcas dang*| dzṝ bi shi ba si bhā si ba hi nanti hi sā dhi rnams las kyang ngo*/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan pa'i dzha dbyangs bcas rnams rim pa bzhin du a na dang*/ a ka dang*| anta rnams su bsgyur bar bya'o/ /rim pa bzhin/ a sa sdod/ ḍu kṛnya/ dzṝ lang tsho nyams pa rnams la sbyar bas/ ā sa na/ kā ra ka /dza ranta sogs sa/ོ/ de yi de yis bsdu ba'o/ zhes pa'i bsdu ba las 'byung ba'i rkyen yin pa la na nya sngon ma can min pa la zhugs pa'ikt+wā ni yapa tu bsgyur bya zhing*/ dper brjod mang du brjod zin cing*/ pra kṛtyasogs so/ /gnyis pa la spyir btang*/ dmigs bsal lo/ /dang po ni byings kyi mtha'i tsa dang dza dag gi gzugs ni rkyen dhuṭa dang po can dang*/ dbyangs dang po can yin kyang gha rjes su 'brel ba'i rkyen pha rol la/ rim pa bzhin ka dang ga dag tu 'gyur ro/ /ḍu pa tsa/ tya dza/ bhañdzo/ bhū dzo gya gyu/ tṛn/ ghanya/ phyi ma gnyis la kta sbyar bas/ pā ka ta/
pā ka/ tya ktaṃ/ tyā ga/

bhagna/ bhu gna/ ta'i na'o*/ /n+yāng kuḥ bhṛ guḥ mang guḥ dū re pā kaḥ spha le pā kaḥ bi ṣaṃ ga/me ghaḥ shrā pā kaḥ ta kraṃ/ ba kraṃ/ ba kraḥ a ba dā ghaḥ ni dā ghaḥ zhes pa rnams ni n+yang ku la sogs pa yin la/ de rnams kyi sgrub gzhi'i tsa dza ga nyid du bsgrur bar ma zad ha'i gzugs kyang*/ gha nyid du bsgyur ba bya'o/ /añtsu 'gro/ ni sngon/ ni la añtshi las so zhes pas/ ku'i rkyen/ 'dis tsa'i ka /rgyu mtshan med na zhes pas/ nya'i na sde pa la zhes pas nga*/ de ltar na n+yang ku'o/ /de bzhin du bhrasdza'i 'tshed/ bhrasdza'i dbyi ba'ang ngo zhes pas ku/ gra hi sogs kyis saṃ pra/ bhṛ guḥ a ba dang ni sngon ma can gyi da ha thal bar byed/ ghanya sbyar bas/ a ba dā ghaḥ ni dā ghaḥ gnyis pa ni/ kū dzi gsal ba'i sgra| khardza'aphyid/ gardza sgra'i don sogs byings ka sde dang po dang*/ bradza 'gro/ a dza 'phen pa rnams kyi tsa dza ni ka ga dag tu 'gyur ba min no/ /de rnams las ghanya/ kū dzaḥ khardzdzaḥ gardzdzaḥ pa ri brā dzaḥ sa mā dza: ghyaṇa sbyar na/ kū dzyaḥ sogs so/ /der ma zad bhrā dza dang*/ tārdza dang*/ sho tsya dang*/ tyā dzyaḥ sogs kyang mthong bas/ bhṝ dzṛ gsal ba/ tardza sdigs/ shu tsa mya ngan/ tya dza nyams pa rnams la ghanya dang ghyaṇa dang sbyang ba'ang tsa dza ma bsgyur bar gsal lo/ /rkyen ghyaṇa pha rol la ab shyaṃ sngon ma can lta bu gdon mi za ba'i don la sbyor ba la'ang mi 'asgyur ro/ /a ba shya pā tsyaṃ/ pra sngon ma can gyi ba tsa smra/ ṛ tsi tu tsi yā tsi zhes pa ṛ tsa bstod/ tu tsa gsal/ ṭu yā tsṛ slong*/ tya dza 'dor ba rnams kyi/ tsa dza yang*/ ghyaṇa pha rol la ka gar mi 'gyur ro/ /pra bā tsya/ ar tsya/ ro tsya/ yā tsya/ tyā dza/ ba tsa brjod pa'i tsa ni/ sgra ma yin pa'i don la ka ru mi bsgyurazhing*/ sgra la bsgyur bar bya'o/ /wā tsyaṃ/ bā kya/ ni dang pra dag sngon ma la yu dzir sbyor ba'i dza yig nus pa'i don la 'jug na ghyaṇa la bsgyur bar mi bya'o/

/ni yo dzyaḥ pra yo dzyaḥ nus pa min na/ ni yo gya/ pra yo gya/ bhu dza skyong ba'i dza yig ni zas kyi don la 'jug na ghyaṇa la mi bsgyur ro/ bho dzyaṃ pa yā saṃ zas min na bhoghyaḥ shā ṭa kaḥ bhu dza skyong ba dang*/ ni sngon ma'i usdza mnam pa ni/ n+yubdza ste/ de dag lag pa dang nad kyi don dag la 'jug pa la ghyuṇa la mi bsgyur ro/ /bho dzaḥ n+yubdza/ 'di gnyis la ya yang med pas tshig phrad do/ /lag pa dang*/ nad min na/ bho gaḥ n+yu pa gaḥ gsum pa ni/ dri shir lta ba las ṭaka dang*/ kwipa dang*// saka rnams sbyar ba la ha sha ṣa tsha sogs dang rdzogs pa la yang na byas pa ni dṛka dang*/ dṛsha dang*| dṛkṣa rnams yin la/ de rnams pha rol la sa ma na zhes pa'i gzugs ni sa nyid du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /si dṛ sha /sa dṛkṣaḥ dṛka/ dṛ sha/ dṛkṣa zhes pa de gsum pha rol la i daṃ gyi gzugs ni ī ru 'gyur zhing*/ kim gyi gzugs ni kī dang a das kyi gzugs a mū dang*/ sarba nā ma'i gzugs ni ā ru 'gyur bas/ ī dṛka /sogs dang kī dṛka sogs dang a mu dṛka sogs dang*/ tā drika/ yādṛka sogs so/ /sarba nā ma dang*/der ma zad/ bi shwa ka dang*/ de ba dag gi'ang*/ mtha'i dbyangs dang po can zhes pa dang po dang*/ la sogs skad dod gcig pas/ dbyangs la sogs pa ni añtsa ti zhes pa añtsu 'gro ba'i byings/ kwipa mtha' can pha rol la a dṛ zhes par bsgyur bar bya'o/ /byings de la tad dang*| yata dang/ yang pi shwa ka dang de ba rnams sngon/ kwipa/ tad sogs kyi mtha'i dbyangs sogs a dṛ bsgyur bas/ ta dr+yang*/ ya dr+yang*/ bi shwa tr+yang de ba dr+yang*| byings kyi tsa yig ga dang*/ de la nya nga dang*/ brtsegs pa'i mtha' dbyi ba rnams ni/ si'i rjes sa/ོ/ kwipa'i mtha' can gi añtsa ti la sa ha dang saṃ dang*/ ti ras rnams kyi gzugs ni/ rim pa bzhin sa dhṛ dang sa mi dang*/ ti ri rnams su sgyur bar bya'o/ sa nga*/ sa myang*/ tir yang*/ lhan cig 'gro/

yang dag par 'gro/ 'khyog por 'gro zhes pa'o/ /da ni añtsu bor te/ kwipa pha rol la/ ru ha rab tu skye ba'i/ ha'i yang na dha dang yang na ta byas pas/ bi ru dhau/ bi ruta/ bi sngon du med na/ si la ha sha ṣa tsha zhes pas ḍa dang*/ rdzogs pa la yang nas ṭa byas pas/ oṃ badzra she kha ra ru ṭa ma ṭa bhū ru ṭa shi ro ruṭa ces sogs 'byung ngo*// byings kyi mtha'i ma yig ni/ kwipa pha rol la na ru 'gyur zhing*/ kwa nsu dang ya sgra'i rjes su nga ro ā ga ma lta bu'i ba dang ma dag pha rol la'ang na ru bsgyur bar bya'o// sha mu/ kwipa/ pra shā na/ sogs dang*/ gaml̥/ kwansu/ ya sgra dang de'i bya ba byas pas/ dza ga nwān/ dzaṃ ganmaḥ mchog gi sbyor bar gam las tse krī yi ta 'jigs pa'i bshad pas ya dbyi zhing*/ uṇa sogs kyi mdor las byin te de'i sa rnam bcad du bsgyur bas byings mtha'i bcos pa'i na yig de n-i/ dbyangs pha rol la byings rang nyid kyi gzugs/ ji lta ba de nyid du bya ste/ dbyangs kyi nang nas āta ces pa/ a ring po min pa la'o/ /sha mu/ pra sngon/ kwipa/ lnga pa'i u pa dhā zhes pas/ ring po/ byings kyis ma'i na'o/ /pra shān/ de la au dzas/ pra shā mau/ pra shā maḥ dbyangs min na/ pra shān bhyaḥ gsum pa la iṭa la dang kta'i ta yig la dang*/ ba yig gi lus 'gyur la dogs pa bcad pa'o/ /dang po la nges pa dang*/ ma nges pa dang*/ spel bar bshad pa'o/ dang po la sgrub pa dang*/ dgag pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ gong du kun bshad bdun par bshad pa'i iṭa ā ga ma'i spros pa rnams rgya cher 'chad pa yin pas/ iṭa'i rnam gzhag gong du bshad pa tsam du nges sam zhe na/ de tsam du ma nges te/ byings adhi zhes pa/ ṛ 'gro ba dang*/ iṇa 'gro ba dang*/ a da za ba'i lus 'gyur ghasl̥ dbyangs gcig pa dang*/ pā btung ba sogs āta mtha' rnams kyi rkyen bansi ni/ kwansu ste/ de la iṭa ā ga ma 'gyur ro/ /thams cad la kwansu kwa na dag pa ro3kṣā bzhin 'ang ngo zhes pas gong du pa ro3kṣā la gang bshad pa rnams bya ste/

kun la gnyis brjod pa dang*/ dang po la ṛ yig gi a yig dang*/ dang po'i ā'i thams cad du'o/ /zhes pas ring po dang*/ ṛ'i r dang*/ gnyis pa la in gyi pa ro ྅ kṣā la yon tan med pa la abhyā sa ring po dang*/ gam han sogs kyis ghas kyi a dbyi ba dang*/ pā la iṭa la'ang ngo zhes pas/ ā dbyi ba sogs byas pas/ ā ri bān dang*/ ā yi bān dang*| dza kṣi bān dang*/ pa pī bān/ da dī bān rnams so/ /dbyangs gcig pa ni/ ḍu pa tsa sogs kyang ste/ pe tsi bān/ thams cad kyang si'i mtha' can sngar bzhin no| |rkyen de nyid la byings gam dang han dang*/ bid dang*/ bi sha dang*/ dṛ sha zhes pa/ gaml̥ 'gro/ ha na 'tshe/ bi da shes/ be sha 'jug/dṛ shir lta ba rnams kyi mthar iṭa yang na'o/ /dang po gnyis la gam han zhes pas/ u pa dhā dbyi ba dang/ phyis pa la ha'i gha dang*/ ita med pa la/ ba ma dag la yang ngos ma na ru bsgyur bas/ dzagmi bān/ dza gnwān/ dza ghni bān/ dzagha nwān/ gzhan rnams la| bi bi di bā na/ bi bi dwān/ bi bi shi wān/ bi bi shwān/ da dṛ shi bān/ da dṛ shwān| dā shṛ sbyin pa dang*/ ṣa ha bzod pa dang*/ mi ha 'khrud pa rnams la/ kwansu dang*| a bhyā sa dbyi ba dang*/ iṭa med pa dang*/ u pa dhā ring po dang*/ ha phyi ma ḍha ru bsgyur ba rnams tshig phrad du byas pa ni/ dā shwān dang/ sā hwān dang/ mi ḍhā na'ang ngo*/ /gnyis pa ni/ shrinya bsten pa dang*/ yu spel/ lūnya gcod pa sogs u yig mtha' can dang*/ bṛnya 'dams pa'am bṛng zhu ba dang*/ tṝ rkyal ba sogs ṝta mtha' can rnams kyi mthar ni rkyen kt+wā sogs ka yig rjes su 'brel ba rnams la/ iṭa thob pa min no/ /shṛ taḥ shṛ ta bān/ shri twā*/ de bzhin du/ yu taḥ sogs dang lūnya la/ lū sogs kyi ta na ru bsgyur bas/ lū naḥ lū na bān/ de zhin du bṛ taḥ swo dang*/ tṝ la/ ra las niṣṭha 'i'o zhes pas ta'i na/ ṝta mtha'i sogs/ tīrṇaḥ ti ghoṣa bta ces pa ni sgra ldan te/

rkyen sgra ldan dang*/ ti dag la'ang iṭa thob pa min te/ rkyen sgra ldan dang ti yang kṛta kyi rkyen la yin gyi kun bshad kyi rkyen sgra ldan dang*/ ti dag la'ang iṇa thob pa min te sgra ldan dang ti yang kṛta yang kṛta kyi rkyen la yin gyi/ kun bshad kyi rkyen sgra ldan dang ti la iṭa mi 'gog ces pa'o/ /ī sha dbang phyug la'o zhes pa'i byings la ba ra dang*/ dī pi 'bar ba la ra dang kta sbyar ba lta bu ste/ ī shwā raḥ dī praḥ dīptaḥ 'o na gṛ hi ti/ u pa sni hi ti bha ṇi ti zhes sogs ci zhe na/ na nyas bstan pa mi rtag pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ / gnyis pa ni/ i ṣu 'dod/ sa ha zhes pa ṣa ha bzod/ lu bha chags/ ru ṣa/ ṛṃ ṣa 'tshe ba rnams kyi mthar tṛ tsa lta bu'i ta'i rkyen la iṭa yang na thob pa'o/ /eṣta/ e ṣi tā/ so ḍhā/ sa hi tā/ lobdhā/ lo bhi tā/ ro ṣi ṭā/ ro ṣitā/ ṣa reṣtā/ re ṣi tā/ sa hi ba ha zhes pas/ u pa dhā'i o dang*/ dha la ḍha'i dbyi ba dang dhuṭa rnams kyi zhes pas/ bha ba ru bsgyur ba'o/ /ra dha 'tshe sogs pas/ dṛ pa tshim| tṛ pa dga'/ mu ha rnam par rmongs/ dru ha 'tshed/ ṣtu ha skyug/ṣṇi ha dga'| ṇa sha mi mthong ba rnams las kyang ta'i rkyen la iṭa yang na'o/ /rkyen ni triṇa lta bu ste/ ra dhi tā/ raddhā/ tarbi tā/ tarba tā sogs dang*/ mo hi tā/ mo ḍha/ tro hi tā/ drogdhā/ 'di la ā drug par da dang po'i ha'i gha dang*/ ā brgyad par dhuṭa rnams kyi bzhi pa rnams la gsum pa ga tro hi tā/ dro ḍhā/ sno hi tā/ snogdhā/ sno hi tā/ snegdhā/ 'di'i dpe brjod gnyis la yi ge pa'i skyon yin nam snyam ste brtag par bya'o/ /gzhung gang gis ha yig ga ru bsgyur ba yin na shi tā/ niṣtā 'di la masdz-i na sha dag gi dhūṭa la'o/ /zhes pas ma ā ga ma'o/ swarti sū ti sū ya ti zhes pa'i/ sbṛ sgra dang nye bar gdung*/ ṣūng srog chags skye/ ṣūng srog chags rab tu skye ba la yaṇa bi sbyar ba rnams dang*/

gu hū sbed pa sogs ūta rjes su 'brel pa rnams las ta'i rkyen la iṭa yang na sbyar bar bya'o/ swa ri tā/ swartā/ pra sa bi tā/ gnyis dang go hi tā/ go ḍha rnams so/ /sha mu sogs uta rjes su 'brel ba rnams dang*/ pūng dag pa dang*/ kl̥ sha nye bar gdung ba rnams kyi kt+rā la iṭa yang na'o/ /sha mi twā| shānt+wā/ pa bi twā/ sū twā/ kle shi twā kliṣt+wā/ gsum pa la'ang nges pa dang ma nges pa dang*/ slar yang nges pa dang ma nges pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kt+wa gzhir byas pa la/ yang na zhes pa bzlog ste/ dzṝ ṣa lang tsho nyams/ o brashtsi gcod pa dag gi mthar iṭa nges par 'gyur ba'o/ /dza ri twā/ brashtsi twā/ lu bha rnam par rmongs pa'i byings 'di rnams rmongs pa'i don la iṭa'o/ /lo bhi twā/ kṣu dhi bkres/ ba sa gnas pa dag gi'ang iṭa'o/ kṣu dhi twā/ u ṣi twā/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇa'o/ /byings de las kt+wa las iṭa 'gyur bar ma zad/ niṭhā la'ang iṭa nges so/ /kṣu dhi ta/ kṣudhi ta bān/ u ṣi ta/ u ṣi ta bān/ gnyis pa ni/ sū dang*/ kli sha dag gi byings mthar ni niṣṭhā la iṭa yang na'o/ pa bi ta/ pū ta/ kliṣta/ ḍīng 'gro/ ṭu o shwi 'gro ba 'phel/ dī pī 'bar ba sogs/ īta rjes su 'brel ba rnams dang*/ bṛ tu 'jug pa dang*/ sha mu zhi ba sogs| iṭa yang na ba rnams kyi mthar ni/ niṣtā pha rol la iṭa thob pa ma yin no| |iṭa yang na ba mtha' dag la'am zhe na/ pa ti ni ṣkuṣa dag ma yin pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ de gnyis la iṭa thob bo/ /ḍī na/ ḍī na bān/ shū na/ shū na bā na/ lta bu sogs dang zhes pas/ ta'i na dang phyi ma la sam pra dang*/ de mtha' ring po byas pa'o/ /de bzhin du dīpta/ bṛtta/ shānta/ rnams la sbyar ro/ / dmigs bsal gnyis ni/ pa 'gro /nir sngon ma can gyi kuṣa sbyor ba la niṣṭha/ pa ti sta/ niṣku ṣi ta/ nyi mi dā gsher/ nyi ṣwa pa/ ṣwi dā y-in lus kyi 'gyur byed sogs āta rjes su 'brel ba'i byings las kyang niṣṭhā la iṭa 'gyur ba min no/

/nyi dang ā rjes su 'brel/ da las da'i 'ang ngo zhes pas/ da dang rkyen gyi ta yang na ru bsgyur bas/ minna/ minna bān/ swinna/ swi bān/ 'on kyang āta rjes 'brel gyi byings las brjod bya dngos po dang dang po'i las dag la niṣṭhā pha rol iṭa yang na'o/ /dngos po la ma ning la kta dang si mu byas pas/ minnaṃ/ mi di taṃ/ swi nāṃ/ swi di taṃ/ dang po'i las la pra minnaṃ/ pra mi di taṃ/ sogs so/ /gsum pa ni kṣu bhi bā hi swa ni dhwa ni zhes pas/ kṣu bha g.yo/ bā hu rab tu 'bad/ swa na dhwa na sgra/ pha ṇi ka ṣi ghu ṣa zhes pa phaṇa 'gro/ ka ṣa 'tshe/ ghu ṣir rnam par sgrogs/ 'di rnams kyi byings ni kta pha rol la mantha dang*/ bhṛ sha dang*/ ma nas dang*/ ta mas dang*/ a nā yas dang*/ kṛtstsha dang*/ bi shabda zhes pa bsgyur na/ srub pa dang*/ shin tu ba dang*/ yid dang*/ mun pa dang*/ tshegs med pa dang*/ 'o rgyal ba dang*/ sgra'i bye brag rnams kyi don las iṭa 'gyur ba min no/ /gha ḍha sogs dang*/ dhūṭa bcos pa dang*/ ṣa dang ṭa stesogs kyi bya ba dang*/ lnga pa'i u pa dhā ring po sogs byas pas/ kṣubdha/ bā dhāṃ/ swāntaṃ?/ dhwāntaṃ/ phaṇḍaṃ/ kaṣtaṃ/ ghuṣtaṃ/ srub pa sogs min na/ kṣu bhi ta/ la ke chags pa'i byings la ka'i rkyen dang iṭa med pa dang*/ na tshig phrad du byas pa ni/ lagna/ mleṣa mi gsal bar brjod pa la kta/ iṭa med pa dang e yig i ru bsgyur ba tshig phrad byas pas/ ml̥ṣta/ bi sngon ma can gyi re bhṛ sgra la sngar bzhin byas pas/ bi ribdha rnams/ rims pa bzhin nus pa dang mi gsal ba dang*/ dbyangs rnams la sbyor ba na iṭa med pas/ mdor bkod yig gzugs ji bzhin no/ /pa ri snga ma can gyi bṛ hi dang dṛ hi 'phel ba dag la kta sbyar bas/ pa ri bṛ ḍha dṛ ḍhazhes pa dag rim pa bzhin/ pra bhū zhes pa mnga' bdag dang*/ ba la ba ta ces pa stobs ldan gyi don dag la sbyor ba na iṭa med pa tshig phrad da/ོ/ saṃ dang ni dang bi rnams sngon ma las/

arti 'gro ba la ste slong ba la'o zhes pa'i byings las niṣṭhā la -iṭa mi 'gyur ro/ /da las ces sogs byas pas/ sa marṇ+ṇa/ ṇyarṇ+ṇa/ byarṇ+ṇa/ a bhi las pha rol gyi arta de nyid las nye ba'i don la de bzhin na/ོ/ dkon mchog gsum la lhag par dad/ /ces pa ni/ ratna tra yā yā bhyarṇ+ṇaḥ pra sā daḥ yi dam la sbyor na/ sa mā dā na/ de bā bhyarṇ+ṇaḥ zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni ru ṣi zhes pa/ ruṣa khro/ a ma nad/ nyi twar mgyogs/ saṃ sngon ma can gyi ghu ṣir sgra/ ā sngon ma can gyi swa na sgra/ rnams kyi mthar niṣṭhā la iṭa yang na'o/ /ru ṣi ta/ ru ṣta/ a mi ta/ ānta/ twa ri ta/ turṇa/ saṃ ghu ṣi ta/ saṃ ghuṣta/ ā swa ni ta/ ā swanta/ hṛ ṣi zhes pa hṛṣa ngo tsha ba'i byings las yu'i don rnams la/ niṣṭhā la iṭa yang na'o// hṛṣta ni lo mā ni/ hṛ ṣi tā ni lo mā ni/ dzas/ ma ning la shi dang*/ nu ā ga ma dang*/ de la u pa dhā ring po byas pa'o/ /da mu sha mu zhi/ pū ri/ da su nye bar 'jog

/spa sha gnod/ tsha da sgrib/ dzñā khong du chud pa rnams la/ kti'i rkyen byas pas/ dānta/ shānta/ pūrṇ+ṇa/ dasta/ spaṣta/ tshanna/ dzñapta rnams kyang tshig phrad du byas te/ de rnams in kā ri ta'i mtha' can la'o/ /dzña la pa ā ga ma byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa la nges pa dang*/ ma nges pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byings kyi cha shas kyi ra yig las pha rol gyi niṣṭha'i ta yig ni na yig tu bsgyur bar bya ste/ 'on kyang pṝ skyong*/ murtstshi rmongs/ ma di dga'/ khyā gtam/ dhyai sems pa la mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge'i sogs kyi bya ba byas pas ni dhyā zhes pa ste/ de rnams las pha rol gyi niṣṭhi'i ta yig ni na ru 'gyur ba min no/ /dmigs bsal phyi ma gsum ni da las de'i 'ang ngo zhes dang*/ āṭa las ces pas thob pa la 'dis dgag pa'o/ /kṝ rnam par g.yeng*/ shṝ 'tshe/ kta dang*/ kta bantu/ shṝ u yig ces pas/ iṭa med/ ṛta mtha'i yon tan med pa la ir/ nā mi'i ra ba zhes pas ring po/ tsand+ra par/ a tsa las ra ha las gnyis so/ /kīrṇ+ṇa/ kīrṇ+ṇa bān/ shīrṇ+ṇa/ shrīrṇ+ṇa bān/ ra las pha rol min na/ kṛnya las kṛta/ ni ṣṭhā ma yin na/ tri tsa dang sbyar bas/ kartā/ dmigs bsal rnams la/ pū rta/ murta/ marta/ khyā ta/ dhyā ta*/ pa da 'gro/ a da za| bi thob/ ṣa 'jig/kandir skems/ tshi dir gnyis su byed/ bhi dir 'joms/ undī gsher ba sogs byings mtha'i da las pha rol gyi niṣṭha'i ta'i na ste da'i gzugs kyang na yig tu bsgyur bar bya'o/ /nyer bsgyur dang sbyar na/ u pa samsanna/ annaṃ/ binnaṃ/ sannaṃ/ sogs nas/ sa munnaṃ sogs so/ /āta mtha' na yod pa la byings kyi cha shas su gyur pa'i mthar gnas brtsegs pa'i byings las pha rol niṣṭhā'i ta yang na ru bsgyur bar bya'o/ /drā smad/ glai dga' ba zad pa la sbyar na/ bi drā ṇa/ bi drā ṇa bān sogs byings kyi cha shas ma yin na/ spyir mthar gnas brtsegs pa tsam gyis mi 'gyur te/ nīr sngon ma can gyi yā thob pa lta bu la/

de tshang yang*/ nirya taḥ zhes gnas pas so/ /lūnya gcod pa nas bzung ste/ bṛta sgra la'o zhes pa'i bar ni/ lū sogs yin pas de rnams dang*/ o bi dzī yid 'byung*/ o la dzī dang*/ o masdzi skyengs pa sogs o rjes su 'brel ba'i byings rnams las kyang*/ niṣṭha'i ta'i na'o/ /lū naḥsogs dang*/ bignaḥ lagnaḥ sogs so/ brashtsi zhes pa/ o brashtsu gcod pa'i byings las ni ṣṭha'i ta na ru 'gyur bar ma zad/ brashtsi masdza dag gi zhes pas tsa dbyi zhing sha yig ka ru bsgyur ba'ang bya'o/ /bṛkṇaḥ bṛkṇaban yon tan med pa la saṃ pra byas pa'o/ /kṣi zad pa las niṣṭhā'i ta'i na ste/ de yang niṣṭhā la'ang ngo zhes pas/ kṣi ring por byas pa las so kṣī ṇa/ kṣī ṇa bān/ shyaing 'gro ba las grub pa'i shyā las reg pa min pa'i don la'ang de bzhin no/ /khu ba'i gong po la shyā'i'o zhes pas/ saṃ pra/ shī ni ghṛ taṃ| shī naṃ me daṃ/ añtsa zhes pa/ añtsu 'gro ba las/ nges par kun sbyin pa min pa'i don la yang de bzhin no/ /a nu ṣaṃ ga dbyi zhing*/ tsa'i ka byas pas/ akṇa saṃ dang sbyar na/ sa makṇaḥ.añtsi ta zhes sogs su ta'i na ma byas pa ni/ iṭas bar du chod pas so/ /'o na antsi las iṭa med do zhes ma bshad dam zhe na*/ mchod pa'i don la/ antsi las aṭa dgag pa mi 'dod de/ na nya yis bstan pa mi rtag pa'i phyir ro/ /di ba zhes pa di bu rtse ba las le lo can gyi don la niṣṭhā ta'i na'o/ /āng sngon/ tsha ba dag gi lnga pa la'ang sha ūṭa/ ā dyū na/ gnyis pa ni| hrī ngo tsha/ ghra dri len*/ trā/ unda/ nud/ bid cesapa/ tyaing skyong*/ u ndī klas/ ṇu da ded/ bi da rnam par dpyod pa rnams kyi mthar ni/ niṣṭhā'i ta na ru yang na 'gyur ba'o/ /hrī ṇa/ hrī taḥ ghrā ṇaḥ ghra taḥ trā ṇaḥ trā taḥ sa munna/ sa munta/ nunna/ nunta/ bi na/ binta/ ita rjes su 'brel ba min pa zhes sogs kyis/ unda'i na dbyi ba dang*/ saṃ sngon ma byas pa'o/ /niṣṭhā'i ta yig 'gyur phyin cad na yin pas kyang ma khyab ste/

kṣai zad/ shu ṣi skems/ ḍu pa tsa rnams kyi mthar byung ba'i niṣṭhā'i ta yig ni rim pa bzhin ma dang ka dang ba rnams su 'gyur bas so/ /kṣa ma shuṣka pa kwa/ pra sngon ma can gyi ṣt+yai sgra dang kun tu tshogs pa'i byings las/ mtshams sbyor gyi mtha'i zhes sogs byas pa ni/ prast+yā zhes pa ste/ de'i mthar byung ba'i niṣṭhā'i ta yig ni yang na ma ru 'gyur ba'o/ /saṃ pra dang de mtha'i ring po byas pas/ prastī ma/ prastī ta/ bā 'gro ba la nir sngon/ phrad las kta'i ta yig na ru byas pa ni| nirbā ṇa ste/ de ni ni bā ta ces pa/ rlung min pa'i don la 'jug pa na/ de ltar byed pa tshig phrad do/ /bhi dir ṛ 'gro/ bi thob pa rnams la/ kta byas pas| bhitta ṛ ṇa bitta zhes pa rnams su gyur pa ni rim pa bzhin/ dum bu dang*/ bu lon dang*/ longs spyod kyi don rnams la 'jug pa la tshig phrad do/ /nyi phā rnam par rgyu/ kṣī bṛ dyaḍa/ kṛ sha phra mor byed/ lā ghṛ nus/ de la uta sngon/ kta dang po la tsar pha rol dag gi a'i uta/ kta'i ta yig la ru bsgyur/ gzhan rnams la rkyen gyi gsal byed dbyi ba tshig phrad tu byas pas phulla dang*/ kṣi pa dang*| kṛ sha dang*/ ullā gha rnams ni tshig phrad yin te/ de yang nyer bsgyur med pa las pha rol tu byung ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /gsum pa ni gong du kṛta rkang pa dang por tsha ba dag gi sha ūṭa'o/ /zhes pa'i ūṭa de nyid la lus 'gyur ba yod dam med snyam na/ ā yig ring po las pha rol tu byung ba'i ūṭa'i gzugs ni/ kṛta kyi rkyen pha rol 'phel bar 'gyur ba'o/ /pra sngon ma can gyi ṇu bstod/ su sngon ma can gyi bhū yod/ a ti sngon ma'i pūng dag /āng sngon ma can gyi yu spel rnams la in 'phel ba/ au āb/ ming la sngon ma la zhes pas ma nin dang*| tika dang*/ kwipa rnams rim bzhin sbyar nas/ kā ti kā ri ta dbyi/ tsha ba dag gi lnga pa la'ang zhes pas ba yig rnams uṭa'o/

/ṭa yig 'dis don/ 'dis uṭa'i 'phel ba byas pas/ ratna tra yaṃ su pū dzya pra ṇau mā/ sad dha rmaṃ su bhau tiḥ shabda pa dā ti pau byā ka ra ṇa mā yauḥ dkon mchog gsum la mchod cing bstod par shog /dam pa'i chos rnams rab tu 'byor 'gyur cig/sgra dang tshig rnams shin tu dag par shog /lung du bstan pa kun tu 'phel bar shog /ces pa'o/ de ltar na gong du bshad pa ltar/ le'u'i mgo zhabs su/ grub pa dang 'phel ba sogs ni/ bstan bcos don tshan so sor sdud pa dang*/ tshig don dge zhing shis pa'i don du'o/ /zhes pa kṛta rnams su mdo las rkang pa drug pa'i rnam par bshad pa legs par rdzogs so// //mjug gi don la mdzad byang ni gong du brjod/ 'gyur byang ni tshul 'di sogs so/ /dpal ldan phun tshogs kun gyi rtser son dge legs gzi 'bar rdzogs sangs dbang gi rgyal po de/ /blangs nas skye rgu'i dbul ba mtha' dag drungs nas 'byin 'dod shes rab byams brtser ldan rnams kyang*/ /lnga rig legs par shes pa'i rnam dpyod gru gzings che la nges pa kho nar brten dgos shing*| |gsung rab zab mo'i tshig gi ze 'bru'ang legs sbyar nyi ma las gzhan sgron mes gsal mi nus/ /sna tshogs rin chen khams kyi legs par bltams// rkyen dang rnam 'gyur pha mtha' mi mngon zhing*/ /mi zad rnam dbye'i rlong 'khor 'jigs rung bas/ /mkhas rlom ded dpon kun gyis ma rgal ba'i/ /sgra rig rgya mtsho'i pha rol der son nas/ legs sbyar nor bu len 'dod ded dpon kun// dngos kun gsal ba'i blo mig gis sbyar ba'i/ /rnam bshad gru chen 'di nyid cis mi bsten/ /lung du bstan pa'i gzhung bzang kun las bsgrubs/ /dri med rig pa'i khyud mos lhag par bsdams/ /'dus gsal tshig sbyor bsdus don dar chen phyar/ /lhag bsam don gnyer slob ma'i rlung gis bskul/ /sngon med gru chen 'dir zhugs te/ /rnam dpyod brtson pa'i skya ba dang*/

/lhag bsam rlung dar la brten na/ /legs sbyar nor bu'i bdag por 'gyur/ /brjod byed tshig gi me long ma dag na/ /brjod bya don gyi bzhin ras ci zhig gsal/ /bzlas bya sngags kyi dbyangs gsal ma dag na/ /zla byed ngag gi nus pa ji ltar 'byung*// de phyir rang blos ma lcogs pa'i/ /nyes pa'i tshogs la sbyor ba 'ga'/ /phyi dus nyer mkho'i chos min zhes/ /sdang smras byed rnams 'khrul par zad/ /snyigs dus skye bo 'du 'dzi'i chang gis myos/ /chags sdang rmongasapa'i gdol gtam 'brel med smra/ /dam chos legs bshad sgrogs pa phal cher yang*/ /kla klo blun po'i skad kyis lang tsho 'da'/ /de phyir kho bo'i legs bshad 'od stong can/ / thub bstan shar ri'i ba gam la 'dzegs mod/ /log sred dmus long tshogs la mi phan zhing*/ /phrag dog ra ba'i mun pa sel mi nus/ /gang zhig mkhas pa'i khri la 'dzeg 'dod lta ci smos/ /bzlas brjod dag pa'i bsam gtan pa tsam don gnyer na'ang/ /tshul 'dir zhugs shing rnam bshad gru 'dis legs bgrod na// bsam 'phel 'dod rgu'i dbang gi rgyal po myur thob 'gyur/ /'di ni gsung rab snang byed padmo'i gnyen/ /legs bshad rin chen 'byung ba'i chu gter te/ / legs sbyar sgra rig khang bzang 'jug pa'i sgo/ /mkhas pa'i go 'phang sbyin pa'i sbyin bdag yin/ /'on kyang byis blos nyam chung zhing*/ /rmongs mun phyi thag rings pa las/ /nongs gang bla ma mkhas la bshags/ /slar yang mun nag gsal du gsol/ /legs par bshad pa'i nyi ma 'di shar bas/ /bka' drin che ldan bla ma'i thugs rje yi/ /pad mo'i dpal ni bzang por rdzogs gyur cig / mkhas pa'i bung ba legs bshad sgrog par shog /rmongs pa'i gzhir skyes bshes gnyen ngan pa'i chu yis bran/ /log rtog sdong chen gtan tshigs ltar snang yal ga can/ /tshig rtsub me tog gzhung lugs ngan pa'i 'bras ldan pa'i// ljon shing de yang shes rab ral gris drungs 'byin shog
